summary: the authority cases, on the architecture ARCH names, against an everyday kernel with the recovery kernel's banner, one that compiles the write of its whole disk, and raw windows that move one sector a driver call

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 rach2-recovery && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel && mkdir -p ${WORK}/recovery && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK}/recovery rach2-recovery/kernel
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run authority 'run: authority: PASS'
